FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Shutter & Lens Co., we specialize in providing high-quality camera and photo supplies to photography enthusiasts and professionals alike. Our operations are centered around retail sales of photographic equipment, including cameras, lenses, tripods, and accessories, along with a carefully curated selection of lighting and studio gear. We proudly support our customers with knowledgeable staff who are passionate about photography and provide personalized service to help them find the right products for their needs. 

We also offer workshops and classes aimed at enhancing our customers' photography skills, fostering a community of creativity and expertise. Our inventory is valued at under $500,000, allowing us to maintain manageable risk while focusing on our core business. All operations are conducted in compliance with local business licensing and tax regulations, and we uphold high standards of safety and service, avoiding any on-site chemical processing or darkroom activities to minimize potential hazards.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in on-site chemical processing or darkroom operations, nor does it sell or rent drones or provide aerial photography services. We confirm that our inventory value does not regularly exceed $500,000, and we do not offer pet grooming, animal photography, or animal handling services.
